model_role: EXPERIMENTAL RESEARCH condition/defect detector (second stage, runs on panel crops). NOT a panel detector. NOT production. Does not replace weights/yolo_solar.pt or weights/yolo_solar_ground_research_v1.pt.

kaggle.train_duration_human: ~48.6 min (wall-clock longer due to Kaggle queue/setup)

do_not: claim verified CC BY image rights

electrical_damage_semantic_risk.reason: S1 electrical-damage boxes visually correspond to cell cracks, not confirmed electrical failure; source class preserved, NOT relabelled; a high score is NOT electrical-fault diagnosis
electrical_damage_semantic_risk.interpretation: highest precision of any class. This most likely reflects that S1 'electrical-damage' boxes are crisp, well-localised cell-crack features (visually easy) rather than any capacity to diagnose electrical faults. DO NOT read a high score as electrical-fault detection.

training_config.panel_class: NOT included - this is a second-stage condition model, not a panel detector

clean_semantic_limitation: CLEAN is trained only where the source carried explicit clean-region annotations. Absence of a defect detection is NOT proof of Clean. No CLEAN boxes were fabricated.
notes: Experimental research artifact only. Does NOT replace weights/yolo_solar.pt (aerial) or weights/yolo_solar_ground_research_v1.pt (ground panel detector).
No RGB hotspot claim - hotspot requires a separate thermal/IR model.
Real-world 6-image evaluation is QUALITATIVE ONLY (no ground truth, no accuracy/precision/recall/F1/mAP).

results.confusion_matrix_finding: class-vs-class confusion is minimal; the dominant error is missed detections (false negatives -> background): CLEAN 0.50 missed, DUSTY 0.63, BIRD_DROP 0.66, PHYSICAL_DAMAGE 0.45, ELECTRICAL_DAMAGE 0.43. DUSTY/CLEAN also produce the most background false positives.
results.overfitting: none observed - train AND val losses were still decreasing at epoch 100 and val mAP was still rising; the model is UNDERFIT, not overfit. best.pt @ epoch 98.
results.learning_real_features: yes - bird-drop boxes land on actual white droppings (several 0.9-1.0 confidence hits on real splats); CLEAN/DUSTY track panel cleanliness. Caveat: many source images carry stock-photo watermarks (Shutterstock), a possible confound.

real_world_qualitative.note: QUALITATIVE ONLY, no ground truth. Predictions are raw model outputs, not facts. Stage-1 ground detector flagged 'cracked' on 2 photos but the condition model predicted no PHYSICAL/ELECTRICAL on those crops.
